acceptanceCriteria.text: Independent builder work executes concurrently with an explicit dependency graph rather than accidental shared-state ordering.
Final generated resources and manifest remain byte-for-byte deterministic for fixed injected inputs except documented volatile fields.
Each builder failure retains bounded attributable diagnostics; one rejection does not swallow another failure silently.
Shared GitHub/API/process limits are respected and concurrency is bounded.
Existing Review Pages generation/schema/publication tests remain green.
Focused timing evidence demonstrates whether wall-clock generation improves on representative fixtures or a real PR run.
No builder's semantic ownership is duplicated or moved into workflow YAML.

issue.title: chore: parallelize independent Review Pages package builders
